title: [Improvement] Add a Bolus Reminder in Carbs Dialog
body:
The idea is to be able to set a reminder for a later bolus, when you start to eat (Enter Carbs in Carbs Button) but you have a low BG and/or an important negative delta...

In screenshot below I started to eat at 12:42 but my BG value was 87mg/dl and Delta -8 mg/dl for the last 5 minutes...
=> I always hesitate to give a significant bolus in this situation, especially with a very fast insulin (Lyumjev)...
=> but I often forget to bolus soon enough after my meal

Trigger to show a "Remind Bolus CheckBox" in Carbs dialog could be something like:
       BG + 3 * Delta <= 70mg/dl (or 3.9mmol/l)
Trigger to remind bolus could be:
       5 min Delta >= 0 and  BG value >= 70 mg/dl (or 3.9mmol/l)

=> It was at 13:13 in my case in second screenshot so about 30 min later

![Screenshot_20211021-125705_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/138271357-93a6adb8-bdd3-41ac-9956-ea0e6ac20511.jpg)

![Screenshot_20211021-131334_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/138271462-621b1daa-299f-44ad-a83a-0fbcce497a02.jpg)

comments.body: I'd say enter at least carbs. then aps will start large SMBs on BG rise if you forget to bolus

That's what I always do (enter carbs), but sometimes I forget to bolus later (and when I remember it's often too late, BG is already above 150 and rising very fast...)
And SMBs (even large) are generally not sufficient to avoid very high bg without a real bolus...
Development done I test it and will do a PR soon
